local AnimEvents = {};

function AttachToAnimEvent(event_name, callback, refData)
	if(type(callback) == "function") then
		if(AnimEvents[event_name] ~= nil) then
			Trace("ERROR: "..evnet_name.." animation event already defined and will be replaced");
		end
		AnimEvents[event_name] = {mycallback=callback, refData=refData}
	end
end

function DetachFromAnimEvent(event_name, callback)
	AnimEvents[event_name] = nil;
end

local TimerEvents = {}

function StartTimerCB(timeMs, loop, callback, refData)
	if(type(callback) ~= "function") then
		return StartTimer(timeMs, loop);
	else
		local timerId = StartTimer(timeMs, loop);

		TimerEvents[timerId] = {callback = callback, loop = loop, refData = refData};

		return timerId;
	end
end

function StopTimerCB(timerId)
	TimerEvents[timerId] = nil;
	StopTimer(timerId);
end

-- Called each time a Timer expires
function OnTimer(timerId)
	local cb_info = TimerEvents[timerId];

	if(cb_info) then
		cb_info.callback(timerId, cb_info.refData);

		-- If it is not a looping timer, then we clear it from the callback list
		if(not cb_info.loop) then
			TimerEvents[timerId] = nil;
		end
	end
end
